# Ibrahim Jaafar

> AI Specialist: automation, AI agents and business systems. Based in Lebanon (Beirut time), open to remote roles, can start immediately.

Main developer on the 3-person R&D team at Blue House Films, where he shipped 9 internal tools to production in six weeks. Builds and runs his own multi-agent system (Hermes Agent on Telegram). 5+ years in engineering and manufacturing before moving into AI.
